The Main Menu:Mario: Play as Mario to try and beat BowserSonic: Play as Sonic to try and beat Dr. EggmanExtras: Explaned laterCredits: See who made this gameHelp: That's what your in use the arrow keys to switch
ControlsMario controls:Arrow keys: move (up is jump)Space: FireballWall Jumping: Jump on to a wall then press upSonic controls:Arrow keys: moveSpace: Jump and attack
Extras:Here you can see what you have done. You get a prize for beating Bowser or Eggman. There are also achievements that you get for doing stuff.

info.comment: {BYOB} I have made a BYOB version with some new things, but it's too slow. Tell me if you like try to fix it.http://mod-share.freehostingcloud.com/upload/pages/index.php?project=(BYOB)%20Epic%20Boss%20Battles%20-%20Mario%20and%20Sonic%20(v%201.5).ypr{Help me}Help with the next EBB Go here:http://scratch.mit.edu/galleries/view/83453{DOWNLOAD TO PLAY}DOWNLOAD to see your health and for less lag and glitches.{Love It}Remember the Love it button is here!{Spoils}ANY comments that will spoil the game WILL BE DELETED. This also applies to tags.{Updates}July 11 - Fixed a glitch with health bars.July 12 - Added a prize and new stat for Sonic, changed a little graphicsJuly 13 - Added a new prize and achievement for Sonic, new button graphicsAugust 12 - Added a new cheat and fixed a minor glitch. You can now skip the intro by clicking.August 15 - Added some more cheats{Note}Note if it says that  you beat Shadow it means Eggman. I'm too lazy to fix that. Maybe I'll do that later.{F4F)This game is part of the F4F thing. So if your a part of that too just tell me and I'll give you some feedback too. If your not then you should join. It's a good way to get some feedback!http://scratch.mit.edu/galleries/view/89476{About}This game has:Two modesIn game credits and instructionsPrizesAchievementsCheats{Cheats}There are basic instructions in game, but here’s something that it didn’t say:Cheats!!!All the cheats will have little or no affect of your chances to win, their just for fun.{Hints for Cheat}1. What color is (based on what I heard) the coolest new thing in Super Mario Galaxy 22. In what games would you be able to put funny disguises on3. A popular game by 08jackt4. Incredible! Mario’s big and green!5. Yo mama is so __6. What candy tastes like rainbows7. What graphics on computers are made of8. The last one almost NONE of you will be able to do! Only one person on Scratch (other than me) can do it! HAHAHA!!! Oh, wait. You can just download it. NNNOOO!!!{Tags}You can add any tags you want (other then tags that give away cheats.)||V
